prompt: Extract any information about the pfbid format: its prefix, character set (is it base64 standard, base64url, alphanumeric only?), typical length, and any regex patterns used to match/extract it from Facebook URLs. Also note any example URLs shown.
content:
# PFBID Format Information from GitHub Gist

Based on the shared gist content, here's what's documented about the pfbid format:

## Format Characteristics
The pfbid appears in URLs following the pattern: `facebook.com/.../posts/pfbid...`. One regex pattern shown captures it as:
- `"/pfbid[0-9a-zA-Z]+/"` 

This indicates pfbid uses alphanumeric characters (0-9, a-z, A-Z) only—not standard base64.

## Typical Length
The gist mentions "data-content-len" attributes but doesn't specify exact pfbid length. One comment references looking for values matching `\S{20,60}`, suggesting variable-length strings in that range.

## Key Challenge
As noted: "for those looking like `https://www.facebook.com/.../posts/pfbid...`, the post ID can no longer be found in any element" using older methods. The canonical post ID must be extracted from page metadata (the `share_fbid` field) rather than the URL itself.

## Example Pattern
One simplified extraction method referenced: `share_fbid":"(.+?)","` pulls the actual numeric post ID from embedded script tags, which can then replace the pfbid in URLs as `facebook.com/[numeric-id]`.
